description:
Change an agent wallet's session permission mode (non-custodial control plane).

Ports Claude Code's plan/acceptEdits/bypassPermissions ladder to a wallet
with signing power. mode: observe (deny every value-bearing tool outright,
PERMISSION_MODE_BLOCKED) | propose (value-bearing tools return a PROPOSAL
envelope -- proposal_id + params + summary -- instead of executing;
approve within the TTL via approve_proposal) | auto_within_policy (execute
immediately, still capped by every configured WalletPolicy -- the pre-R9
default). The transition is logged as an AgentTransaction audit row.

Scope: the ladder gates ACTIONS that build, sign or move
value -- including set_perp_tpsl, which is an on-chain action despite its
name. It does NOT gate configuration writes: set_wallet_policy,
set_agnta_grant, set_alert, set_liquidation_alert, set_ooda_consent,
set_portfolio_charter and this tool are allowed in every mode, observe
included -- which is how a wallet leaves observe.
name: set_permission_mode
